verdict.rationale: Synctera's first-party docs describe a programmatic KYC/KYB verification solution. It runs identity and watchlist checks for personal and business customers and records the results as `verification` objects. Customers can be created as `PROSPECT` and then activated, and the docs mention document verification, EDD and sandbox test cases for multiple verification flows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of verification result states (pass/fail/review lifecycle), details of the document-collection flow beyond a one-line mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
